name: Pi-Walker
rationale: Turns the Greek letter Pi into a sturdy, wide-brimmed companion whose twin pillars double as walking legs.

name: Neko-Stack
rationale: A calm, loafing terminal cat with whisker ticks and a curled block tail that keeps quiet company beside a prompt.

name: Nocturne-Owl
rationale: A vigilant night-shift owl with tufted brow horns and speckled chest feathers built for late-night debugging sessions.

name: M-Ghost
rationale: A friendly background-daemon phantom with stubby side arms and a three-tail spectral hem representing persistent state.

name: Axo-Bit
rationale: A regenerative axolotl companion with triple gill fronds on each cheek, symbolizing resilient recovery from broken builds.

name: Kitsune-M
rationale: Fuses an angular Mahiro M upper silhouette with a sharp-eared fox face and textured cheek ruffs.

name: Crab-Claw
rationale: A tenacious little terminal crab raising twin pincers with stalked eyes, ready to pinch bugs before they scuttle away.

name: Moth-Loom
rationale: Reclaims the classic Grace Hopper moth as a symmetrical luna-moth companion with wing eyespots and swallowtails.

name: Robo-CRT
rationale: A miniature vintage CRT monitor buddy with a tilted antenna and recessed phosphor screen that smiles back at the operator.

name: Puffer-Orb
rationale: A round, spiky puffer companion that expands defensively around fragile code while keeping an approachable expression.

name: Duck-Debug
rationale: The classic rubber-duck debugging partner rendered in side profile, floating calmly on terminal waterline ripples.

name: Bonsai-Byte
rationale: A sculptural terminal bonsai in a stepped planter tray, representing patient cultivation and long-term memory growth.

name: M-Pi-Monolith
rationale: An architectural monogram whose upper twin peaks form Mahiro's M while the crossbar and pillars below resolve into Pi.

name: Torii-Pi
rationale: Blends a curved Torii threshold gate with the geometry of Pi, marking the entrance to a focused coding workspace.

name: Beacon-Lantern
rationale: A caged wayfinder lantern with a layered block-shaded flame core that stays lit across sessions.

name: Polaris-Spark
rationale: A symmetrical cardinal compass star with a suspended center spark inside a hollow diamond chamber.

name: Iso-Cube
rationale: An isometric three-tone voxel cube with a recessed inner chamber representing modular, multi-dimensional context.

name: Keycap-Pi
rationale: A sculpted mechanical keycap with a centered Pi legend, celebrating tactile craftsmanship at the command line.

name: Astro-Jelly
rationale: A bioluminescent jellyfish drifting on four curled tentacles, evoking calm flow-state exploration through deep codebases.

name: Crown-Slime
rationale: A cheerful droplet companion topped with a three-point M crown, blending RPG party loyalty with minimal terminal block art.
